title: Woke up drenched
text: Woke up drenched. Comfy but it make you sweat really bad, due to the plastic lining. I had hoped the quilted top would help with that, but it doesn't.

features: A soft brushed Microfiber cover and a layer of hypoallergenic down alternative fill create a plush surface

description: The soft comfort of a mattress pad now offers the added benefit of waterproof protection. This cozy mattress pad has a quiet waterproof membrane that protects your mattress from spills and accidents. The liquid-proof backing is designed to guard the mattress surface from stains while allowing airflow for breathable comfort. The durable elasticized skirt with deep pockets stretches to create a smooth, even fit on any type of mattress. High-quality materials and exceptional design create a secure fit that ensures this waterproof pad does not alter the feel of your mattress. Materials: cover and fill: 100 percent polyester fibers; backing: 100 percent polyurethane.
